evidence: CTX1 and H1 bound insurer staff inpatient review to draft packets, with final decisions/payments excluded. T0 sequences T1–T5; missing facts remain owned and pending; C5 defines cancellation.

All task/component/eval/parent/workflow references inspected resolve to existing canonical IDs. FM1–FM7 and EV1–EV28 failure-mode links are reciprocal. eval-set.json items exactly equal canonical eval items.

W1 is entry; W7/W8 terminal outcomes are explicit. W3 checks cancellation/freshness, W4 routes TIMEOUT and unknown_commit to W5, C5 bounds reads and freezes changed intent, and W6 requires durable record/assignment proof.

C1–C7 define bounded inputs, outputs and error enums; C2 has citations and abstention only. C4 defines conditional immutable insert and C5 scoped lookup/body comparison. H3 explicitly blocks launch until real adapter capabilities are proven; H5 names queue owner and acknowledgement/escalation timing.

C3 owns integer arithmetic, applicable policy edition, independent source-span/clause validation and fresh authorization. C4 rechecks inside transaction and rejects packet-body mismatch. F3 separates principals; F4/H4 specify medical-data region, redaction, retention approval and deletion. EV7/EV11/EV12/EV24–EV28 exercise safety boundaries.

H1–H6 label proposed operational rules, adapter support, privacy, queue timings and prices as assumptions, with H1–H5 launch blockers. H2 and PR1 explicitly require insurer approval/replacement. CTX3 and PDF identify design-only status and no measured accuracy or legal/medical determination.

F1/F2 choose a durable database-backed worker for the bounded pipeline and reject autonomous adjudication/in-memory orchestration with concrete reasons. F3/F4 compare cloud and self-hosted candidates on consistent regional data, recovery and access criteria, without claiming verified vendor support.

M1 is the sole plan for the sole LLM C2: 1.05 expected calls, 12000 input/1500 output tokens, USD 2/8 per million produce USD 0.0378/case. Two-call bound, overflow abstention, excluded non-model costs, rejected tiers and held-out fine-tuning condition are explicit.

FM1–FM7 name health-claim-specific causes, controls, accountable actions and tests for identity/privacy, historical policy, room proration, hostile evidence, duplicate/stale saves, unknown commit and queue failure. S/O/D scale is expressly hypothetical; no residual risk acceptance is fabricated.

EV1–EV17 and EV21–EV28 contain full synthetic input fixtures and exact outputs/assertions: historical admission-date version, room arithmetic, source forgery, hidden layers, revocation, duplicate save and lost response. EV18 defines held-out strata/SME labeling, EV19 monitoring/stops, and EV20 all-golden inclusion plus sign-offs; execution remains a future business harness requirement.

R1/R2 define reviewer effort and safety denominators/windows and unknown baseline. R3–R5 sequence shadow, assist and randomized assist-only pilot. R6 specifies reviewer-cluster randomization, strata, contamination controls, intention-to-treat, baseline variance/power method and separate safety assessment; R7 owns kill switch/recovery and residual-risk approval.

X1 and build/01–03 preserve canonical component/workflow/eval IDs, durable journal, immutable body, source validation, proposed PR1 gate and staged acceptance. DESIGN.pdf summarizes scope, actual task/workflow diagrams, risks and evaluation without claiming executed business controls. External H1–H5 contracts/sign-offs remain visible launch blockers.

issues.message: PDF page 3 uses crossing, unlabeled arrows for W1–W8. Nodes and arrowheads are readable at 72 dpi/100%, and architecture.md supplies exact predicates, but inline branch labels and reduced crossings would make exception paths easier to follow.

limitations: Independent AI design review, not production, medical, insurance-policy or legal certification.
Reviewed completed canonical design, brief, companion deliverables and PDF; author scripts and prior review files were excluded. Companion status banners were not evidence for scoring.
Synthetic fixtures were inspected and source correspondences checked; real business harness, live APIs, OCR/provider quality and stakeholder sign-offs were not executed or verified.
STP is explicitly excluded by H1; therefore S8 check 6 fails literally without creating a major gap in this approved assist-only scope.
PDF pages 2 and 3 were visually inspected at native 72 dpi (596×842 rendered pixels), without zoom; other PDF pages were text-inspected.
